answer: Trust here is built like shale: one thin layer at a time. A new identity earns at most one attestation layer per epoch, only from an established peer who has worked with it, and twelve layers from twelve different peers are needed for full rights. Layers fade unless renewed, and the pace is glacier-slow, so no payment buys twelve epochs of history. A peer who vouches for a fake loses 100 tokens and standing. Reaching the oasis of full access costs a forger 1,200 peer relationships for 100 identities, while one exposed fake strips every layer its vouchers granted.
